notes.title: Patch 1.2.0 + Future Plans
notes.notes:
Three Patches in 3 weeks!! 
As I am slowly starting to get out from behind bug fixes and minor lore updates I will begin spending time working towards DLC and more gameplay mechanics.
Another huge thanks to everyone thats been keeping me in the loop about feedback and bug-reports! 
None of it falls on death ears and i appreciate everyone playing this game! 

 
Bug fixes - 
MORE Lore, Voice lines, subtitles & updated objectives
Walking animation updated so it wont show the flashlight moving
Camera Shake Taken Down a notch while running
Updated Respawns for the Windmill Level
Updated the ladder in the house and Opera
The Mouse No longer goes straight to the LOAD button when you hit the menu
Updated the Wave color on BOSS phase 3 to match his health
Additional Achievement for Finding the broken Down van (shout out the Twitch Family)
Fixed Hidden Achievement that has been broken
Plenty of minor Quality of Life Changes + Updates

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.0
notes.notes:
A gigantic THANK YOU to everyone that has played the game so far!
All the notes and playthroughs have been a huge eye opener for how people would interpret/play this game and ive been doin my best to stay on top of any major issues i see. 

NEW UPDATES:
Extra Scares 
Subtitles
Expanded on all Lore with cassettes and notes
Updated Chandelier cutscene 
Updated Objectives for more clear goals
More reliable & consistent Save's Points
MORE SCARES!
Updated hitboxes
Boss Fight Rebalance
+ A lot of minor bug fixes and improvements 

More to come soon

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hey all
Listened and watched to a lot of feedback!

Update 1.0.1 Features:
Larger hitboxes -
Took off motion blur by default- 
More clear instructions for certain areas - 
Meshes moved/deleted for ease and less confusion - 
Optimized all Level - 
Updated Death Cutscenes - 
Flashlight will now turn on for a few seconds when out of battery so you can see for a little and not in the complete dark -
Bones will respawn if they drop through the floor - 
BOSS FIGHT REWORK -  Nerfed all three stages and fixed the summoning animation's fog glitch 

Looking forward to hearing more of your thoughts and feedback.
